question:
(i) Obtain the expression for the change in potential energy of a charge $q$ displaced through distance $d$ along a uniform external electric field $E$.
(ii) A charge $+5\,\mu\text{C}$ is moved slowly through $0.40\text{ m}$ in the direction of a uniform electric field of magnitude $2 \times 10^3\text{ N C}^{-1}$. Calculate the change in potential energy of the charge and state whether it increases or decreases.

options.A:
(i) $\Delta U=-qEd$ for displacement along the field.
(ii) $\Delta U=-(5\times10^{-6})(2\times10^3)(0.40)=-4.0\times10^{-3}\,\text{J}$; potential energy decreases
options.B:
(i) $\Delta U=+qEd$ for displacement along the field.
(ii) $\Delta U=+4.0\times10^{-3}\,\text{J}$; potential energy increases
options.D:
(i) $\Delta U=-qEd$.
(ii) $\Delta U=0$ because the field is uniform
